# Reporte general de evaluaciones — fixes Cargo/Fecha/Yate/Respuestas — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Fix 5 defects in the Excel generated by `generateGeneralReportEvaluations`: a hardcoded "Cargo" value, a raw date serial instead of a formatted date, all-caps yacht names, and survey answers always written as text (losing the number/text distinction) even though blank answers were already handled correctly.

**Architecture:** Two small pure-function helpers (`extractApellido`, `capitalizeYachtName`) go into a new `src/utils/reportFormatting.js` module, unit-tested with no DB. A new `Staffervice.getPositionByLastName(lastName)` method is added to the existing `src/services/catalogs/staff.services.js` for the Staff/Positions lookup. The controller wires these together: it resolves every unique "apellido" once via `Promise.all` before the row-filling loop (so the loop itself stays synchronous), then uses the helpers/lookup while filling each row.

**Tech Stack:** Node.js, Express, Sequelize (MySQL), excel4node, Jest + supertest (integration tests against a real local MySQL test DB), `xlsx` (SheetJS, already a project dependency) for parsing the generated workbook in tests.

## Global Constraints

- Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-31-reporte-general-evaluaciones-cargo-fixes-design.md` — every requirement there must be covered.
- Follow existing test conventions: integration tests via `supertest` against a real MySQL DB reset with `bootTestApp()`/`db.sync({ force: true })` (see `tests/helpers/testApp.js`) — no mocking of Sequelize models.
- Test files run with `npx jest <path> --runInBand` (matches the project's `npm test` script, which is `jest --runInBand`).
- Do not modify `EvaluationService.getEvaluationsByCompany` or `SurveyScoring.asignarPuntaje` (out of scope per spec).
- Do not add a cargo lookup for the evaluator, only for the evaluated (per spec).
- Commit messages in Spanish, imperative, matching existing history style (e.g. `fix: ...`, `feat: ...`, `test: ...`).

### Task 1: Pure formatting helpers — `extractApellido` and `capitalizeYachtName`

**Files:**
- Create: `src/utils/reportFormatting.js`
- Test: `tests/unit/utils/reportFormatting.test.js`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nothing (pure functions, no DB, no other project modules).
- Produces (used by Task 3):
  - `extractApellido(fullName: string): string` — returns the last 2 whitespace-separated words of `fullName`, joined by a single space. Returns the single word if only one is present. Returns `''` for empty/non-string input.
  - `capitalizeYachtName(name: string): string` — returns `name` with each word capitalized (first letter upper, rest lower), except words that are entirely roman numerals (`I`, `II`, `III`, `IV`, `V`, ...) which are kept fully uppercase. Returns `name` unchanged (including `null`/`undefined`) if it is not a string.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the helpers**

Create `src/utils/reportFormatting.js`:

```js
const ROMAN_NUMERAL_REGEX = /^[IVXLCDM]+$/i;

const extractApellido = (fullName) => {
    if (!fullName || typeof fullName !== 'string') return '';
    const words = fullName.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (words.length === 0) return '';
    if (words.length === 1) return words[0];
    return words.slice(-2).join(' ');
};

const capitalizeYachtName = (name) => {
    if (!name || typeof name !== 'string') return name;
    return name
        .trim()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map(word => (
            ROMAN_NUMERAL_REGEX.test(word)
                ? word.toUpperCase()
                : word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1).toLowerCase()
        ))
        .join(' ');
};

module.exports = { extractApellido, capitalizeYachtName };
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the service method**

In `src/services/catalogs/staff.services.js`, insert this new method immediately after the closing brace of `getStaffByEmail` (currently lines 55-65), before `getStaffCompanies`:

```js
    static async getPositionByLastName(lastName) {
        try {
            if (!lastName) return null;

            const staff = await Staff.findOne({
                where: { lastName, active: true },
                attributes: ['id', 'lastName'],
                include: [{
                    model: Positions,
                    as: 'staff_position',
                    attributes: ['id', 'name'],
                }],
            });

            return staff?.staff_position?.name || null;
        } catch (error) {
            throw error;
        }
    }
```

```js
        result.forEach((item, idx) => {
            const row = 11 + idx; // Fila donde empieza la data
            const formulario = item.formulario?.name || "Sin Datos";
            const evaluador = item.evaluator;

            const cargo = cargoMap.get(extractApellido(evaluado)) || "Sin Datos";
            const yate = capitalizeYachtName(item.empresa?.yacht?.name) || "N/A";
            const fecha = item.updatedAt;
            const estado = item.state || "Sin Datos";

            // Datos base
            ws.cell(row, 1).string(formulario).style(infoStyle);
            ws.cell(row, 2).string(evaluador).style(infoStyle);
            ws.cell(row, 3).string(evaluado).style(infoStyle);
            ws.cell(row, 4).string(cargo).style(infoStyle);
            ws.cell(row, 5).string(yate).style(infoStyle);
            ws.cell(row, 6).date(fecha).style(dateStyle);
            ws.cell(row, 7).string(estado).style(infoStyle);

            // Obtén todas las respuestas de la evaluación
            const respuestas = item.respuestas?.map(r => SurveyScoring.asignarPuntaje(r.answer)) || [];

            // Llenar las 10 columnas de respuestas, respetando el tipo (numero vs texto)
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                const respuesta = respuestas[i];
                if (respuesta === null || respuesta === undefined || respuesta === '') {
                    ws.cell(row, 8 + i).string('').style(infoStyle);
                } else if (typeof respuesta === 'number') {
                    ws.cell(row, 8 + i).number(respuesta).style(infoStyle);
                } else {
                    ws.cell(row, 8 + i).string(String(respuesta)).style(infoStyle);
                }
            }
        });
```
